name: game-design-review
description: Invoke when the user wants feedback on a game design document, GDD review, design evaluation, or consistency check on an existing design. Triggers on: "review my GDD", "design feedback", "evaluate design", "design document review", "GDD critique". Do NOT invoke for brainstorming new ideas (use game-brainstorm) or balance tuning (use game-balance-check). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
